card.tagline: dance move in which the dancer's legs repeatedly move or flutter like butterfly wings
card.profile: The butterfly dance is a dance move in which the dancer's legs repeatedly move or flutter like butterfly wings. It originated within the Jamaican music genre called Dancehall. This dance move has been featured in Dancehall music videos since the 1970s. It has since become popularized along with the popularization of Dancehall music culture.
